metadata.description: A comprehensive cyber-physical flow diagram of a drinking water treatment facility including intake, coagulation/flocculation, sedimentation, filtration, disinfection, and chemical post-treatment processes with associated SCADA/ICS infrastructure

elements.name: Water Source
elements.description: Natural water source providing raw water input to the treatment facility

elements.name: Landfill
elements.description: Waste disposal site receiving plant waste and sediment from treatment processes

elements.name: Water Distribution Network
elements.description: Municipal water distribution system receiving treated water from the facility

elements.name: Onsite Human Plant Operator(s)
elements.description: Human operators physically present at the facility who interact with both physical equipment and cyber systems for monitoring and control

elements.name: Electric Utility Provider
elements.description: External electrical utility providing power to facility operations with both physical energy delivery and cyber monitoring/billing

elements.name: Offsite Human Plant Operator(s)
elements.description: Human operators monitoring and controlling facility operations remotely via SCADA systems

elements.name: Org Intranet
elements.description: Organization's internal network providing connectivity for administrative and operational systems

elements.name: Internet
elements.description: External internet connectivity enabling remote access, updates, and cloud services

elements.name: Drinking Water Treatment Facility
elements.description: Primary facility perimeter with both physical security (fences, gates, access control) and cyber security boundaries

elements.name: Post-treatment shed
elements.description: Physically secured enclosure housing post-treatment chemical dosing equipment

elements.name: Electrical shed
elements.description: Physically secured enclosure housing main electrical distribution infrastructure

elements.name: Coagulant/Flocculant
elements.description: Chemical storage for coagulation and flocculation agents used in initial treatment stages

elements.name: Sediment
elements.description: Accumulated sediment and particulate matter removed during sedimentation process

elements.name: Chemical Disinfectant
elements.description: Disinfection chemicals (chlorine, UV) used to inactivate pathogens in water

elements.name: Post Chemical
elements.description: Post-treatment chemicals for final water conditioning and pH adjustment

elements.name: Water Storage
elements.description: Treated water storage reservoir maintaining supply for distribution network

elements.name: Intake
elements.description: Process of drawing raw water from source through screens and gates with sensor monitoring and automated control

elements.name: Coagulation/Flocculation
elements.description: Chemical and mechanical process combining coagulant dosing with mixing to destabilize and aggregate suspended particles

elements.name: Sedimentation
elements.description: Gravity-driven settling process removing flocculated particles with mechanical scraping and sensor monitoring

elements.name: Filtration
elements.description: Multi-media filtration process with automated backwash and sensor-based performance monitoring

elements.name: Disinfection
elements.description: Chemical and/or UV disinfection process with automated dosing control and residual monitoring

elements.name: Chemical Posttreatment
elements.description: Final chemical conditioning for pH adjustment and corrosion control with automated dosing

elements.name: Waste collection and disposal
elements.description: Collection and removal of filter residue, sludge, and plant waste with mechanical conveyance

elements.name: Coagulation/Flocculation Tank
elements.description: Physical basin providing mixing chamber and retention time for coagulation/flocculation reactions

elements.name: Sedimentation Tank
elements.description: Physical clarifier basin providing quiescent settling environment for particle removal

elements.name: Filtration Tank
elements.description: Physical filter vessel containing multi-layer media for particulate and microbial removal

elements.name: Disinfection Tank
elements.description: Physical contact chamber providing retention time for disinfectant contact with water

elements.name: Storage Pump
elements.description: Mechanical pump transferring treated water from storage to distribution network

elements.name: RTU Sensors (Level, flow, turbidity, temp, conductivity, pH)
elements.description: Remote Terminal Unit with multiple sensors monitoring intake water quality and flow parameters

elements.name: PLC Actuators (gates, screens, pumps)
elements.description: Programmable Logic Controller managing automated control of intake gates, screens, and pumps

elements.name: PLC Actuators (mixers, dosing pumps, valves)
elements.description: PLC controlling coagulant dosing pumps, mixing equipment, and process valves

elements.name: RTU Sensors (pH, turbidity, streaming current)
elements.description: RTU monitoring coagulation effectiveness through pH, turbidity, and streaming current measurements

elements.name: RTU Sensors (Sludge blanket, turbidity, flow)
elements.description: RTU monitoring sedimentation basin performance including sludge blanket depth and clarified water quality

elements.name: PLC Actuators (clarifiers, sludge scrapers, tube settlers)
elements.description: PLC controlling sedimentation equipment including mechanical scrapers and clarification mechanisms

elements.name: RTU Sensors (Turbidity, ΔP, flow, particle)
elements.description: RTU monitoring filter performance through turbidity, differential pressure, flow rate, and particle counts

elements.name: PLC Actuators (filters, media, backwash)
elements.description: PLC controlling filter operation including media agitation, backwash cycles, and valve sequencing

elements.name: RTU Sensors (Chlorine, ORP, UV, pH, flow)
elements.description: RTU monitoring disinfection effectiveness through chlorine residual, oxidation-reduction potential, UV intensity, and pH

elements.name: PLC Actuators (Feed pumps, UV lamps, dosing valves)
elements.description: PLC controlling disinfectant feed pumps, UV lamp intensity, and dosing valve positions

elements.name: PLC Actuators (Feed pumps, dosing valves)
elements.description: PLC controlling post-treatment chemical feed pumps and dosing valves for final water conditioning

elements.name: RTU Sensors
elements.description: RTU monitoring post-treatment water quality parameters

elements.name: Main Power Distribution Panel
elements.description: Primary electrical distribution system with cyber monitoring and physical circuit protection distributing power throughout facility

elements.name: SCADA Computer/HMI
elements.description: Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition system with Human-Machine Interface for facility-wide monitoring and control

elements.name: Internet Link/Firewall
elements.description: Network security device providing filtered internet connectivity and access control for facility networks
